notifications.finalizationSoonTitle: Gesture now — the cycle can finalize soon
notifications.finalizationSoonBody: The Cycle Finalization Time expires in 5 minutes. Make a Gesture now to extend the cycle and take part in the final allocations.

loading.label: Syncing
loading.tooltip: The app is synchronizing with protocol time before showing the current cycle state.

unavailable.label: Clock unavailable
unavailable.tooltip: The live cycle clock could not be reached. Open cycle details for the latest indexed state.

openingSoon.label: Opening soon
openingSoon.status: Waiting for the next cycle. Gestures open when this countdown reaches zero.
openingSoon.tooltip: This clock counts down to cycle opening. Once it reaches zero, the first Gesture can start the finalization clock.

waitingFirstGesture.label: Awaiting first Gesture
waitingFirstGesture.status: Cycle is open. The first Gesture starts the finalization clock.
waitingFirstGesture.tooltip: No finalization countdown is running yet. The first Gesture starts the cycle timer and begins shaping this Signature.

approach.label: Under 12 hours
approach.status: Cycle is live. Each Gesture can extend the finalization clock.
approach.tooltip: This is the Cycle Finalization Time. When it reaches zero, the Final Gesture participant may finalize the cycle.

finalHour.label: Final hour
finalHour.status: Less than one hour remains before this cycle can finalize.
finalHour.tooltip: The finalization clock is under one hour. New Gestures can still extend the Cycle Finalization Time.

finalTen.label: Final 10 minutes
finalTen.status: Final minutes. Every Gesture can still change the ending.
finalTen.tooltip: The cycle is inside the final ten minutes. The clock is urgent, but a new Gesture can still extend it.

finalMinute.label: Final minute
finalMinute.tooltip: The finalization clock is in its last minute. If it reaches zero, the cycle becomes ready to finalize.

confirming.label: Confirming
confirming.status: The clock reached zero. Confirming on-chain that no last-second Gesture extended the cycle.
confirming.tooltip: The countdown reached zero on this device. Before showing the cycle as ready to finalize, the app verifies directly against the blockchain that the deadline truly passed - a Gesture in the final seconds can still have extended it.

readyToFinalize.label: Ready
readyToFinalize.status: Finalization is ready. A new Gesture can still extend the cycle.
readyToFinalize.tooltip: The Cycle Finalization Time reached zero. The Final Gesture participant may finalize; after the exclusivity window, anyone may finalize and receives the Signature Allocation. Gestures remain possible until finalization executes.

live.label: Cycle is live
live.status: Cycle is live. Each Gesture can extend the finalization clock.
live.tooltip: This is the Cycle Finalization Time. When it reaches zero, the Final Gesture participant may finalize the cycle.

explainer.title: New here? Read the cycle in 30 seconds.
explainer.body: Wait for the cycle to open, make a Gesture once Gestures are available, and watch the finalization clock. Each Gesture helps shape the final Signature, can extend time, and updates who is in line for allocations. When time expires, the cycle finalizes and the reserve distributes on-chain.

form.title: Make Your Gesture
form.subtitle: Choose a gesture method and participate in the active cycle.

rwlk.title: Your Random Walk NFTs
rwlk.tooltip: Attach a RandomWalk NFT to an ETH gesture to receive a 50% Gesture Cost reduction. Each NFT can only be used once.

form.cstTrade: Need CST for this gesture method? Trade ETH for CST on Arbitrum through Uniswap.

reward.economicsDescription: Net CST is the Participation CST reward minus the current CST gesture cost.
reward.previewDescription: Estimated dynamic CST you receive if this gesture lands. The amount depends on time since the previous gesture, and every gesture method has two protections: maximum cost and minimum CST reward.
reward.previewDescriptionV3: Estimated dynamic CST this gesture generates. The entire amount goes to the participant you outbid — and you receive the full CST of the next gesture when someone outbids you. Maximum cost and minimum CST reward protections apply to that amount.
reward.goesToOutbid: Paid in full to the participant you outbid; you earn the next gesture's CST when outbid.
reward.minAcceptedTooltip: The minimum Participation CST reward your transaction will accept. It is the current preview minus your Minimum CST Reward Protection tolerance. If the contract would imprint less by confirmation, the gesture reverts instead of accepting a lower reward.
reward.minAcceptedTooltipAny: Accept any CST reward sends a minimum accepted reward of 0, so the gesture can land with any dynamic CST reward, including none.
reward.netPositive: The CST reward exceeds the CST cost if this lands.
reward.netNegative: Most CST gestures spend more CST than they receive.
reward.durationMismatch: Using on-chain duration ({contractDuration}) because the API reported {apiDuration}.

form.preview: Preview the live gesture options here. Connect a wallet to write your message, attach assets, and submit the gesture on Arbitrum.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.messageTooltip: Leave a message to appear in Gesture Chat. Your message is recorded on-chain with your gesture and remains on the blockchain permanently.
advanced.messagePlaceholder: Leave a message with your gesture...
advanced.attachIntro: Attach tokens or NFTs to your gesture, or adjust gesture-cost collision prevention.

minCstProtection.title: Minimum CST Reward Protection
minCstProtection.body: Participation CST uses a square-root formula based on elapsed time. This setting protects you if another gesture lands first and lowers the amount before your transaction confirms.
minCstProtection.bodyV3: Participation CST accrues linearly with elapsed time. This setting protects you if another gesture lands first and lowers the amount before your transaction confirms.
minCstProtection.acceptAnyBody: Sends a minimum accepted CST reward of 0. Use this when you prefer the gesture to land even if the dynamic CST amount changes before confirmation.
minCstProtection.toleranceLabel: Allow reward to move down by
minCstProtection.revertNote: If the contract would imprint less CST than this minimum by the time your transaction lands, the gesture should revert instead of accepting a lower dynamic CST amount.

collision.title: Collision Prevention
collision.note: Bumps Gesture Cost by {percent}% to avoid collision when two gestures land in the same block. Does not permanently raise the cost.
